items.statement: Driftless scheduling is software that auto-defragments a calendar to protect focus blocks.
items.verbatim_anchor: a calendar that defragments itself around your focus blocks

items.statement: The driftless wedge is auto-rescheduling internal one-on-ones first.
items.verbatim_anchor: the wedge is internal one on ones, nobody defends those slots

items.statement: The user plans to do eight chief-of-staff interviews before writing any driftless code.
items.verbatim_anchor: eight chief of staff interviews before I write a line of code

items.statement: Mira Voss previously told the user that scheduling products die on distribution, not product.
items.verbatim_anchor: Mira keeps saying scheduling dies on distribution, not product

items.statement: Position driftless as a calendar janitor rather than another assistant.

items.statement: The user feels giddy about driftless in a way past ideas never triggered.

items.statement: Manually defragging their own calendar bought the user back six hours a week.

items.statement: The user is timeboxing driftless validation to three weeks, then making a kill-or-commit call.
